He paid cash for everything he's ever done. He wants to get out of the city of Baltimore. He worked for us at one point in time back in the early 2000s as a shipping manager for our catalog company. Jason wanted to farm, wanted to get of Baltimore City and we said, okay, let's look for a place. We are Casey, my wife and I are very much dyed in the wool and native New Englanders. We will not live anywhere else. We've looked at other states, we've lived in other states, Missouri, Illinois, New York, Rhode Island, Maine, New Hampshire and now Connecticut. Connecticut, we wanted to come someplace where it was a little warmer, someplace that had another old house because we are hold house people. And you can't go any further south in New England than Connecticut. So that was part of the reason for looking at Connecticut. The other was looking for a property that had an old house that we could do what we do best with and that's restored, that had enough room for our son to be able to start a career as an organic farmer. And we needed a place that either had an existing accessory apartment, second building or one which had enough space and a town that was willing to let us do it. When we bought this house back in the fall, we closed December 4 and one of the three contingencies that we had when we bought them, when we made the offer on the house was the ability to build what we were calling at that point in time a caretaker cottage and we still think of it that way.

We met with Jim's predecessor the last week that John was here. He walked through it, told us, yes, you can do it. It's a lengthy process, plan on two to three months, but you can do it. We didn't care about the house. We've done this enough time that we could go through it and we knew the kind of stuff we were going to have to do to make this restoration something we would be comfortable with. So with all of that, we chose Andover very carefully. We spent more than nine months looking for a property. And in fact, when we came to look at this, we had a full price cash offer on our house in New Hampshire that we didn't sign off on because we didn't have a house yet.

And we looked at this one and one in Hebron as a matter of fact, the last two. And if this house had not been right for us, we would not have made the move until probably now sometime. So that's the background. Our son is ready and eager to come. We're waiting for this crazy virus malarkey to go away or at least enough so that we can get him up here.
